CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Divisions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Divisions of has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of.

   C. Apply the teaching of Healing of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Healing of to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of? (1 mark)

   D. Use Creation of to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)

7. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Jesus has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story:? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
